DEWALT DCF887N-XJ 18V XR impact driver delivers up to 205Nm of torque for efficient fastening in wood, metal, and more. Features a brushless motor, delivering reduced friction, longer runtime, and extended tool life. Designed with a compact 134mm body and 0.84kg weight, making it ideal for tight spaces and overhead work. The all-metal gearbox ensures durability, while the 1/4" hex quick-release chuck allows fast, one-handed bit changes. The impact driver also offers 3 speed settings, including Precision Drive, for precise and heavy-duty tasks, and a triple LED halo light for improved visibility. An ergonomic soft-grip handle enhances comfort. Ideal versatile tool for professional use. Compatible with all Dewalt 18V XR Li-Ion batteries and chargers (sold separately).
